**sdd/issue-244-a4/spec**

Spec Delta — GitLab Substrate Ladder Awareness (slice A4). Written to openspec/changes/issue-244-a4/spec.md.

REQ-A4-1: GitLab rung-1 computed as OR of three per-provider sub-gates (pipelineMustSucceed, protectedBranches, preReceive) in substrate.mjs evalRung1, replacing the selfHostedPreReceive short-circuit. Scenarios: CP-A2b mirror state (pipelineMustSucceed alone arms rung-1, presence-alone would wrongly report absent), neither gate armed → inactive, short-circuit removed (preReceive sub-gate carries active+verifiable:false instead of bypass).

REQ-A4-2: Honesty — preReceive sub-gate always verifiable:false + mechanism:'pre-receive-config-declared'; brain-governance-status.mjs print layer renders "not remotely detectable; verify via install runbook", never "verified". Data (substrate.mjs) and caveat text (brain-governance-status.mjs) must change together. Scenarios: declared-not-verified renders caveat never "verified"; API-verified gate (protectedBranches) doesn't borrow the caveat.

REQ-A4-3: realBranchProtectionProbe dispatches on config.vcs.provider (mirrors realBrainWritesReviewedProbe). GitLab branch feeds protectedBranches from existing glab api protected_branches read, and NEW pipelineMustSucceed from a new GET /projects/:id read added to gitlab.mjs (~15 lines, only_allow_merge_if_pipeline_succeeds). gitlab.mjs stays GATE_FILE (no CI_API_V4_URL reads, params only, mirrors issueView). Scenarios: dispatch reuses sanctioned config path; unreachable endpoint degrades honestly (available:false + remedy, no throw).

REQ-A4-4: CP-A4a bare-repo push rejection fixture-tested — hooks/pre-receive.test.mjs new case reusing setupFixture/commitAndPush unchanged. Non-compliant push rejected (non-zero exit, ref not updated); compliant push accepted. GIT_AVAILABLE-gated, no GitLab/network.

REQ-A4-5: New GET /projects/:id + protected-branch fixtures marked derived + _provenance (endpoint, live-verifiable by curl per CP-A3a precedent), never recorded (no live-recording pass exists yet). npm test performs no live network/glab process call.

Non-goals: diff-size in pre-receive hook, GitLab-CI job registry, real server hook install (SCIT), CP-A3b/A2b live smoke.

Acceptance split: CP-A4a (this slice) = fully offline fixture-phase, npm test/brain:audit/brain:repo:check/brain:nav green, hard stop PR-as-review. Track A closing (deferred to SCIT) = real-MR block on self-hosted GitLab with pre-receive installed via custom_hooks/.

Sources read: proposal.md (RESOLVED owner ruling section), engram obs #565 (Q1-Q3 ruling), engram obs #566 (explore code map), openspec/changes/issue-239-a3/spec.md (house format precedent — flat REQ-{slice}-N sections, no ADDED/MODIFIED split, since openspec/specs/ is empty in this repo — confirmed via glob).
